# Getting involved {.unnumbered}

Bioconductor thrives through the participation of its users, developers, package maintainers, educators, and community leaders.
You can get involved by asking questions, sharing your experience, improving this handbook, contributing to packages, or helping guide and support the wider community.
No single level of expertise or formal role is required to make a useful contribution.

This section introduces practical ways to participate: how to contribute to the handbook and how to learn about community roles, groups, and activities.
Choose a starting point that fits your interests and time, and build your involvement as you go.
